svg.title: CPA-X · AI service management
svg.desc: A web console for self-hosted CLIProxyAPI: service status, request logs, and usage history at a glance, plus verified, rollback-safe upgrades on Linux / systemd. SHA-256 checks and atomic replacement, with rollback on failure / An upgrade succeeds only when the authenticated API answers / Incremental log parsing with per-scan byte and time budgets
